mechanism: Efavirenz is a CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer that increases chlorpromazine metabolism, reducing its antipsychotic efficacy; concurrent use also increases CNS adverse effects including dizziness and psychiatric symptoms.
action: Monitor antipsychotic efficacy closely and consider increasing chlorpromazine dose or switching to an alternative antipsychotic less affected by enzyme induction; counsel on CNS adverse effect risk.
